launcher_args: launcher accepts only --plan --pins --reservation --output; plan and pins sha flags are passed to the child probe only
guard_formula: 136 per pass verified by static trace: 64 construction guards + 8 decisions x (1 top + 7 chunk + 1 end)

findings.summary: Comment says no MPS call precedes the pre-MPS gate, but ResourceSampler.start() runs _default_probe, which calls torch.mps.driver_allocated_memory(), before the rehash gate.
findings.failure_scenario: Probe run starts sampler thread, which queries MPS driver memory before the rehash-before-MPS gate; the stated 'no MPS call precedes this gate' claim is false, so evidence based on that claim is inaccurate. Runtime effect unverified.

findings.summary: monitor_rss raises on ps nonzero exit before rechecking process.poll(), so a clean child exit racing with ps is recorded as an RSS monitor failure.
findings.failure_scenario: Worker exits 0 between the poll check and the ps call for the worker PID; ps returns nonzero, monitor_error is set, and _main raises 'RSS monitor failed closed' even though the probe passed.

findings.summary: Failures before the try block (imports, verify_inputs, CPU checkpoint loop, second pins/reservation check, sampler.start) raise without writing probe-result.json.
findings.failure_scenario: Strict CPU checkpoint check fails; probe exits 1 with traceback only. Launcher writes failed_child, but no probe-owned metrics or failure reason file exists.

findings.summary: run_cpu_preflight checks only status and mps_operations, not training or requires_grad_any in strict_cpu_loads.
findings.failure_scenario: cpu_preflight reports a load with requires_grad True but status passed; the launcher gate accepts it. The probe's own CPU loop still rejects it before MPS, so no MPS exposure, but the launcher-level gate is weaker than the stated strict CPU preflight.

findings.summary: Launcher enforces a 6 GiB aggregate of launcher plus worker current RSS, while probe enforces worker ru_maxrss separately. calibration-plan.json says rss_and_mps_caps_separate: true.
findings.failure_scenario: Reviewers reading 'separate 6 GiB RSS/MPS' may expect no combined RSS cap; the implemented combined cap is stricter and could fail a run the plan intends to allow. Intent needs confirmation.
